newsitem.title: EGYPT: Misr Oil and Soap profits down in 1995/6.
newsitem.headline: Misr Oil and Soap profits down in 1995/6.

text.p: Misr Oil and Soap made net after-tax profits of 24.881 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, down from 26.885 million in 1994/5, according to audited results made available on Monday.
The financial year ends on June 30.
Profits before tax declined to 34.122 million from 36.169 million in the previous year.
Turnover, however, rose to 471.112 million pounds from 466.615 million in the previous year.
The state privatised about 54 percent of the company's 4.5 million shares in August at 31 pounds each. The shares closed on Sunday at 31.00 pounds.
